description: This Java source file defines an abstract helper class 'ProcessorHelper' used within a code generation framework. It includes methods for analyzing service models, determining code generation capabilities, and resolving native function names for variables related to Pojo and Event objects. The class acts as a base for more specific helper implementations used during processing and code generation phases.

classes.name: ProcessorHelper
classes.description: An abstract helper class providing methods for analyzing service components, determining code generation support, and retrieving native function names for service variables, to be extended with specific implementations.

methods.name: analyze
methods.description: Abstract method called during initialization to analyze a service model.

methods.name: getWrappers
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve an iterator over Wrapper instances used in code generation decisions.

methods.name: shouldGenerateJava
methods.description: Checks if any Wrapper supports generating Java code by examining their language masks.

methods.name: shouldGenerateC
methods.description: Checks if any Wrapper supports generating C code by examining their native language masks.

methods.name: getNativeConstructorForVar
methods.description: Returns the native 'constructor' function name for a given variable by searching Pojo and Event processors.

methods.name: getNativeDestructorForVar
methods.description: Returns the native 'destructor' function name for a variable by searching Pojo and Event processors.

methods.name: getNativeDestructorForVarFromList
methods.description: Returns the 'destroy from list' native function name for a variable.

methods.name: getNativeDestructorForVarFromMap
methods.description: Returns the 'destroy from map' native function name for a variable.

methods.name: getNativeEncodeForVar
methods.description: Retrieves the native 'encode' function name for a variable.

methods.name: getNativeDecodeForVar
methods.description: Retrieves the native 'decode' function name for a variable.
